title: Senior Client Engineer
description:
**Senior Client Engineer (Gurugram-Hybrid)**

**About Finova**

Finova is the UK's leading lending and savings technology provider, supporting one in every five mortgages nationwide. Our agile, cloud-native solutions enable over 60 banks, building societies, specialist lenders, equity release providers and a network of 2,400+ brokers to stay ahead in a competitive market.

Built on open architecture and backed by deep industry expertise, our platform is designed to scale. Each year, we process over £50 billion in loans, manage nearly £50 billion in savings, and support the digital servicing of more than 650,000 UK borrower accounts.

Be part of a team that’s driving innovation, enabling growth and shaping the future of UK lending.

**For Lenders**

Finova offers a flexible, modular technology suite designed to help lenders move faster, scale efficiently and deliver standout digital experiences.

Financial Institutions use Finova to launch products faster, process applications up to 50% more efficiently and reduce operational costs — all while staying fully compliant in a fast-moving market.

**About the Role:**

As a Senior Engineer at Finova, you will play a key role in developing, enhancing, and maintaining our core UK lending and digital banking platforms. You will design and write clean, scalable code using C#, .NET MVC, JavaScript, SQL, and RESTful APIs, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability across our software solutions. Working in an Agile environment, you will participate in code reviews, resolve complex technical issues, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful software features.

**About you:**

* Leading technical delivery on user stories: estimating effort, build complex configurations and integrations.
* Participate in refinement sessions to ensure stories meet acceptance criteria and are sprint ready.
* Mentoring and coaching Developer-level colleagues, reviewing pull requests to uphold coding standards.
* Liaising with clients or third-party engineers on complex technical issues (interfaces, integrations).
* Identifying and mitigating technical risks within sprints, escalating dependencies or blockers as needed.
* Providing release support and contributing to production-issue diagnosis and resolution.

**What will you be doing?**

In terms of your experience, your attitude is everything, but we'd particularly love to see your:

* Experienced or proficiency in C#, .NET MVC, JavaScript, SQL and RESTful APIs. Confidence in code reviews, ensuring quality and adherence to best practice.
* Ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders and escalate issues appropriately.
* Experience of Agile delivery at scale, from planning through to warranty support.
* Demonstrable track record of guiding junior team members through coaching or formal training.
* Commitment to continuous learning, sharing insights via presentations or internal communities.

**What we Offer:**

* **Hybrid working:** We operate on a flexible hybrid model that gives you the choice and freedom to balance working from the office and working remotely.
* **Private medical insurance:** Comprehensive health floater cover covering your spouse and children, ensuring complete medical protection for your family.
* **Family friendly policies:** Our enhanced family-friendly policy goes beyond maternity and paternity leave, offering paid time off for when plans change or alternative paths to parenthood are needed.
* **Flexible Holiday Package:** Enjoy 30 days paid holiday (plus 10 public holidays) with the option to encash or carry forward unused leaves into the next year.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re passionate about this role but don’t meet all the criteria, please reach out, we’d love to discuss how your skills and experiences align with our needs.

title: Associate- Back end Engineer(PEG)
description:
About us
  
  

Bain \& Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
  
  

Who you will work with
  
  

BCN PEG CoE provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast\-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results on a scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed exponential growth, reaching \>250 members today from \~10 members in 2013\. We operate from 4 locations \- 2 in India, 1 in Poland, and 1 in Mexico, and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). We work across industries, including Technology, Consumer Products, Retail and Healthcare. BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set\-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought\-partner with daily deliverables.
  
  

What you’ll do
  
  

* As an Associate (Tech) at BCN PEG, you will bring specialized technical knowledge to product development of internal tools as well as help in end client delivery of cases
* Write clean, reusable, testable, and efficient code to develop scalable, flexible, user\-friendly applications across a robust technology stack including the use of AI and LLMs
* Design, build, and maintain AI\-powered applications using LLMs (especially OpenAI Models) and related technologies
* Implement python\-based API integrations with LLM platforms to enable use cases such as summarization, classification, extraction, reasoning, and workflow automation
* Evaluate potential technologies for adoption, including new frameworks, libraries, and tools
* Support the supervisor in work\-planning and brainstorming projects
* Understand client needs and situations and adapt to case expectations. Show ability to resolve complex problems by applying the relevant analytical/technical tools
* Contribute actively to internal meetings and stakeholder discussions
* Effectively structure communication of insights from own work stream. Deliver clear and professional presentations to the team/team leaders/managers
* Seek appropriate coaching and guidance from supervisors and proactively drive self\-learning for own professional development
* Support team culture through collaboration, ownership, and role\-model behavior
* Leverage opportunities to provide training, coaching and mentoring to fellow team members
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and internal training within the PEG and broader BCN community


About you
  
  

**Must\-have skills:**  

* Strong programming skills in Python and its Frameworks (Fast API/Flask), Proven experience in enterprise service layer delivery.
* Core data processing \& analytics skills via Python (Pandas, NumPy, Xlsxwriter)
* Hands\-on experience working with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI’s Responses API) including prompt design, response handling and Vector Embedding in respective DB.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating external services along with some ORM (Object Relational Mapper) libraries.
* Familiarity with modern development tools like Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
* Good understanding of relational and non\-relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
* Writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
* Understanding of front\-end and back\-end architecture and design principles
* Sound SDLC skills, preferably with experience in an agile environment
* Quick learner, willing to get into the details; good at thriving in a fast\-paced environment and able to work independently
* Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to effectively interface across cross\-functional teams


**Good\-to\-have skills:**  

* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies such as Angular, React and HTMX
* Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and associated components such as EC2, Lambda and S3 for AWS
* Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and NLP
* Basic understanding of Web Services protocols such as SOAP and GRAPHQL design for extensibility and portability


Educational qualification \& Professional experience

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the \#1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.



To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.



As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner's codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production\-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.



This is a hands\-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on\-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.



We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.


### **What you'll do at MongoDB**



In this role, you will


* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB\-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production\-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes\-based private clouds, and self\-managed or restricted on\-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

### **As an ideal candidate, you will have**


* 5\+ years of hands\-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application\-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application\-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction\-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual\-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C\#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self\-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi\-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade\-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on\-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

### **As an ideal candidate, you may also have**


* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward\-deployed, embedded, resident\-engineer, or partner\-engineering role
* Familiarity with event\-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production\-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB's broader product portfolio

### **What you will learn**


* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud\-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data\-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

### **About MongoDB**



MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.



With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.



Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.



To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!



MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.



MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
